suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific temporal risk. Apply only when the catalog anemia diagnosis is specifically sickle cell anemia and CKD is separately established after/within the sickle nephropathy phenotype. Do not generalize this source to iron-deficiency or aplastic anemia; source is sickle-cell-specific. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Anemia (Iron Deficiency, Sickle Cell, Aplastic) matches the source-specific phenotype or population
Independent diagnosis of Chronic Kidney Disease / Renal Failure with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors
Qualified clinical opinion before applying the population-level relationship to an individual case
